name: risk.anomalies

list.description: Read native alert records with adjacent-date bounds and qualified width50.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Native query start, valid YYYYMMDD; to-date must be one day later.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Native query end, valid YYYYMMDD; exactly one day after from-date.

get.description: Read one native root detail online without changing a saved List.

lookup.name: riskEventId
lookup.description: Native lookup sent as riskEventId; use the unprojected List id value.

result_identity.description: Native detail id; exact nonempty string echo of the requested lookup.

purpose: Inspect native risk alerts through bounded inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native nonempty record identity retained without conversion.

identity_description: Native id identifies rows within this leaf and acquisition scope.
limitations: Inquiry-only native JSON and unknown nested fields are retained without projection. Native zero values remain unchanged.

Width50 is qualified by the current frontend and accepted native two-page scope; it is not a measured backend maximum and width10 is not a fallback. SDK quality reports duplicate identities, count shortfall and page gaps; strict refresh publishes complete acquisitions only.
Conflicts keep the last arrival and remain incomplete. Rejected refresh preserves the prior saved capture.
Fixed tenant GUAPW3SG, riskMode=RISK_ALERT, timeZone=GMT+08. Adjacent YYYYMMDD CLI bounds map to native YYYY-MM-DD; unbounded acquisition is unsupported.
Native Risk Time gmtCreate and other GMT+08 source times are retained. Server boundary clock and inclusivity remain unproven; no local date membership or anomaly classification is inferred.
Native Get uses POST form /api/risk/event/detail.json; lookup riskEventId returns one native root object with id.
Get preserves all native nested fields and unknown values; separately queried history, logs and child endpoints remain unqueried.
Get is live-only and publishes no cache or Duckdog data.

List --live --with-detail fetches native Detail only for the selected offset/limit window, returns separate record/detail members and fails atomically on any detail error; saved List data remains unchanged.

examples.title: Read one selected List row with its native detail
